**📅 September 4, 2026**
**📊 Market Sentiment:** Bullish
**🎯 Confidence:** High

**🧠 Key Themes**
• Dovish Fed pivot dominates: Waller signals rate hold, crushing rate-hike bets and igniting a broad equity rally.
• AI capex narrative re-accelerates: Nvidia’s $13B Hugging Face deal and Snowflake’s AI-fueled beat reinforce the compute cycle.
• Bond market stress is being contained by Fed rhetoric, allowing risk assets to decouple from yields for now.

**⚠️ Notable Risks**
• Geopolitical oil spike: Iran strikes Kuwait and Hormuz tanker attacks keep Brent above $95, threatening inflation pass-through.
• Global bond rout is not resolved: Yields near multi-year highs; any hawkish CPI surprise could reverse the risk-on move violently.

**📈 Volatility Outlook:** Falling

**🧾 One-Line Take**
Equities are rallying hard on a dovish Fed repricing, but the bond market and oil remain coiled threats that could snap sentiment on the next data print.
